title: Just like a meddah
goal: Say as I said, it looks as if and it's as though, and read about a family storyteller.

intro.text: After a participle, *gibi* means **as** (*Dediğim gibi*, as I said) or **it looks as if** (*Yağmur yağacak gibi*). *Sanki* opens a comparison, and *tıpkı … gibi* is **just like**. The reading is about a grandmother who tells stories like a meddah.

vocab.en: accent, way of speaking (of a region)
to faint; to love, to be crazy about (colloquial: bayılıyorum)

exercises.title: Babaannemin hikâyeleri
exercises.passage:
Babaannem tıpkı eski meddahlar gibi hikâye anlatır. Bayram akşamları yemekten sonra herkes salonda toplanır, babaannem de koltuğuna oturur. Elinde hep bir mendil olur.

Dediğim gibi, babaannem sıradan bir anlatıcı değil. Hikâyedeki herkesi tek başına oynar. Komşusu Fatma Teyze'yi anlatırken sesini inceltir; sanki gerçekten Fatma Teyze konuşuyormuş gibi. Bakkal Murat Amca'yı taklit ederken gözlüğünü burnunun ucuna indirir ve onun köyünün şivesiyle konuşur.

Geçen bayram yine bir hikâye anlattı: gençken İstanbul'a ilk kez gelmiş, otobüsten yanlış durakta inmiş ve saatlerce kaybolmuş. Bunu anlatırken sanki hâlâ o sokaklarda kayboluyormuş gibi etrafına bakıyordu. Hepimiz kahkahalarla güldük; küçük kardeşim gülmekten bayılacak gibi oldu.

Hikâyelerin sonunda babaannem hep aynı şeyi söyler: “Bu hikâyeler yalan değil, ama doğru da değil. Siz nasıl isterseniz öyle inanın.”

Bildiğiniz gibi, eskiden kahvehanelerde meddahlar vardı. Bence babaannem o zaman yaşasaydı, en ünlü meddahlardan biri olurdu.
exercises.translation: My grandmother tells stories just like the meddahs of old. On holiday evenings, after dinner, everyone gathers in the living room and my grandmother sits down in her armchair. She always has a handkerchief in her hand. As I said, my grandmother is no ordinary storyteller. She plays everyone in the story on her own. When she talks about her neighbour Fatma Teyze, she makes her voice higher, as if Fatma Teyze herself were really speaking. When she imitates Murat Amca, the grocer, she lowers her glasses to the tip of her nose and speaks with the accent of his village. Last holiday she told another story: when she was young, she came to Istanbul for the first time, got off the bus at the wrong stop and was lost for hours. As she told it, she kept looking around as if she were still lost in those streets. We all roared with laughter; my little brother nearly fainted from laughing. At the end of her stories, my grandmother always says the same thing: “These stories aren't lies, but they aren't true either. Believe them as you like.” As you know, there used to be meddahs in the coffeehouses. I think if my grandmother had lived then, she would have been one of the most famous meddahs.

questions.q: What does the grandmother always have in her hand when she tells stories?
*Sanki hâlâ o sokaklarda kayboluyormuş gibi etrafına bakıyordu.* What does it tell you?
options: She looked around as if she were still lost in those streets
She was lost again in those streets
She was looking for those streets on a map
questions.explain: *Sanki … -(I)yormuş gibi*: an appearance, acted out while she tells the story.

questions.q: What happened to the writer's little brother?
questions.explain: *Bayılacak gibi oldu*: `-(y)AcAk gibi olmak` is a near miss; he didn't faint.

options: Her grandmother would have been a famous meddah in the old days
Her grandmother was a meddah when she was young
Meddahs still tell stories in every coffeehouse
questions.explain: *O zaman yaşasaydı … olurdu*: an unreal past, from [B2 unit 1](gp-unreal-past).

exercises.en: As I said, I'm not in the office tomorrow.
exercises.explain: *-DIğI gibi* with a possessive: *dediğim gibi*, **as I said**.

exercises.prompt: As you know, the meeting is at three.
exercises.explain: *bil-diğ-iniz gibi*: **as you know**, to several people or politely.

accept: It looks like it is going to rain.
It looks as if it is going to rain.
It seems [like|as if] it is going to rain.

exercises.question: *Merdivende düşecek gibi oldum.* What happened?
options: I nearly fell on the stairs.
I'm going to fall on the stairs.

why.1: `-(y)AcAk gibi olmak` describes a near miss: you **almost** fell.
why.2: *Oldum* is past: the moment is over.

exercises.explain: *düşecek gibi oldum*: **I felt I was about to fall**, so **I nearly fell**.

exercises.en: It's as if I'm in a dream.

exercises.prompt: She talks just like her mother.

exercises.label: *demek* + *gibi*: as I said, as you said…
exercises.explain: The object participle with its possessive, then *gibi*: *de-diğ-im gibi*. For **they**: *dedikleri gibi*.

exercises.prompt: Do it the way you like.

accept: He went to bed as soon as he got home.
He went to bed as soon as he [came|arrived] home.
She went to bed as soon as she [got|came|arrived] home.
As soon as he [got|came|arrived] home, he went to bed.
As soon as she [got|came|arrived] home, she went to bed.

exercises.task: You've just seen a performer who imitates people, like a meddah. Write three or four sentences about the show for a friend, with *sanki*, `-mIş gibi` and `-DIğI gibi` at least once each.
models: Dün akşam bir gösteri izledim. Sahnede tek bir adam vardı, ama sanki on kişi konuşuyormuş gibiydi. Yaşlı bir kadını taklit ederken tıpkı benim babaannem gibi konuşuyordu. Dediğim gibi, sen de mutlaka git!
Kafede bir anlatıcı dinledik. Hikâyeyi anlatırken hiçbir şey olmamış gibi sakin duruyordu, sonra birden bağırdı ve hepimiz korktuk. Sanki gerçekten oradaydık. Bildiğin gibi ben hikâyelere bayılırım.
checklist: *Sanki* opens a comparison, often with `-mIş gibi`: *sanki … konuşuyormuş gibi*
`-mIş gibi` for an appearance: *hiçbir şey olmamış gibi*
`-DIğI gibi` with a possessive: *dediğim gibi*, *bildiğin gibi*

exercises.en: This job doesn't look like it'll ever be finished.

exercises.question: What did Ece do?

context.en: Ece was really strange last night.

options: She acted as if she didn't know Selin at all.

why.1: `-(I)yormuş gibi` is an appearance: Ece does know Selin.
why.2: Nothing in the sentence says she introduced herself.

exercises.explain: *Tanımıyormuş gibi davrandı*: **she acted as if she didn't know me**.
